name: Ritamvara Bhattacharya

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ritamvara Bhattacharya is an English-language poet associated with Darjeeling. Her books include the collaborative chapbook In the Mirror, Our Graves (2021), written with Ravi Shanker N., also known as Ra Sh, and the solo collection August Rituals, published by Writers Workshop in 2022. Her poems also appear in Ink Pantry, where her devotional poem “At your touch” accompanies two other pieces.

In her Kabita Live poems, sorrow and delight find expression through music and the natural world. “At your Touch” turns tears into an offering and finally into a lute string. In “Bliss”, a dream brings stars and fish together at a riverbank before a note of Ahir Bhairav becomes an inward prayer. Both poems move from intimate feeling towards an expansive, imagined presence.
